record.title: Execute the unchanged native ADC suite through isolated prerequisites
record.intent: Obtain actual guest evidence for the whole ADC sequence observer after resolving the preflight dependency.
requirements: Recheck the new manifest, unchanged native/profile/per-arm verifier, stock artifact preservation and capacity before exactly one fresh private-adc-sequence-02 attempt. Install no stock application.
Execute only the twelve frozen arms and verifiers. Stop at the first unexpected result and preserve all evidence without adapting or retrying the experiment.

Evaluate complete predicted sequence, worker dependency, both synthetic read protocols, uninterrupted atomic progress, precise final stop, fail-closed negative controls and thread cleanup from actual guest records. Do not substitute host synthetic evidence for guest observations.

Verify system_server continuity, Enforcing state, final health, index coverage and teardown. If preflight fails again, report zero guest outcomes explicitly. Commit and push the conclusion before the decision gate.
acceptance: One frozen attempt has a precise positive or negative conclusion and preserved evidence committed and pushed.
